verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents Workers secrets, environment variables, or team-member roles and permissions. The only access-related material covers scoping Cloudflare API tokens to specific resources and permission levels. That is an adjacent account-level control, not central team management of access, secrets, and environment variables, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can manage team-level access, secrets, and environment variables centrally

citations.quote: granting Zone DNS Read access to a zone example.com will allow the token to read DNS records only for that specific zone
Modify the token's permissions. After selecting a permissions group (Account, User, or Zone), choose what level of access to grant the token.
